title: Разработка программного обеспечения для системы электронных государственных закупок — ADB Проект 55109-001 Фаза 1
title_en: e-Procurement System Software Development — ADB Project 55109-001 Phase 1
ai_digital_scope: Software development firm engagement for e-procurement system digitalization under ADB TA grant. Scope: replace paper-based operations with electronic platform, modernize existing procurement software, blockchain-based bid/performance securities, API integration with state treasury. QCBS 90:10 quality-cost ratio. 42-month contract.
win_probability_rationale: ADB donor rules procurement = most transparent modality. New system (no incumbent). 90:10 quality-cost ratio strongly favors technical capability over price. Foreign firms with e-procurement implementation experience (Eastern Europe, Baltic states, CIS) are well-positioned. Blockchain bid securities is a differentiator.

title: IT-аудит системы электронных государственных закупок — ADB Проект 55109-001
title_en: IT Audit of e-Procurement System — ADB Project 55109-001
ai_digital_scope: Independent IT audit firm for 6-month engagement. Audit of the e-procurement system architecture, security review, penetration testing, compliance with KG state procurement law (2022), ADB procurement framework. Deliverable: audit report and remediation recommendations.
win_probability_rationale: Small, specialized contract. ADB rules. No incumbent. International IT audit firms (Big 4 affiliates, specialized cybersecurity auditors) are natural candidates. Short engagement reduces barriers to entry.

title: Закупка суперкомпьютеров / GPU-кластера для Министерства цифрового развития / УДП КР
title_en: Procurement of Supercomputers / GPU Cluster for Ministry of Digital Development / Presidential Administration UDP
ai_digital_scope: 4 supercomputer systems with GPU accelerators. Previous tender failed due to export control issues with Nvidia (H100 chips on ECCN). Budget: 220 million KGS (~$2.5M). New tender re-launched with US Embassy engagement. Systems to support national AI strategy, government AI workloads, Digital Som infrastructure. Potential Chinese GPU alternative (Huawei Ascend) being evaluated.
win_probability_rationale: Previous tender failed — creates opportunity for new bidder. US export control on Nvidia H100 chips creates genuine uncertainty. Chinese GPU vendors (Huawei Ascend 910B) are viable alternative and not subject to US export rules. European and Russian alternatives also under evaluation. ICB format with foreign eligibility.

title: Разработка программного обеспечения для инфраструктуры цифрового сома (ЦБДК) — кошельки и AML
title_en: Digital Som CBDC Infrastructure Software Development — Wallets, AML/KYC Platform
ai_digital_scope: Digital Som CBDC technical infrastructure under Law №74 (April 2025). Full implementation by January 2027. Phase: consumer wallet apps (iOS/Android), bank integration APIs, Central Treasury connection, offline transaction capability, AML/KYC AI monitoring, integration with Tunduk identity layer. National Bank authority over issuance and regulatory framework.
win_probability_rationale: Brand new system — no incumbent. National Bank procurement is more transparent than line ministry procurement. CBDC is technically sophisticated requiring specialized international expertise. SWIFT, BIS Innovation Hub, and specialized fintech firms (R3, Hyperledger ecosystem) are natural candidates. Russian fintech firms (ЦБ РФ CBDC experience) are competitive.

title: Модернизация платформы Тундук — API-шлюз и управление данными
title_en: Tunduk Platform Modernization — API Gateway and Data Management Module
ai_digital_scope: Post-April 2026 reorganization — Tunduk transferred from former Mintsifry to GP Infocom under Presidential Administration. New UDP leadership issuing TORs. Modernization: REST API gateway upgrade, data analytics dashboard for government data flows, FHIR health data integration, 30% more digital services target (EU-set KPI), new Tunduk mobile app integration.
win_probability_rationale: Estonian EGA already has deep partnership with Tunduk (X-Road fork origin). WB Digital CASA funding makes this donor-rules procurement. EGA/Cybernetica (UXP) are natural incumbents for core upgrade. Window exists for analytics layer, health data integration, and mobile app components as separate sub-contracts.

title: Внедрение цифрового здравоохранения — электронные медицинские записи и телемедицина (совместная программа ООН)
title_en: Digital Health Implementation — Electronic Health Records and Telemedicine (UN Joint Programme)
ai_digital_scope: UN Joint Programme (WHO+UNDP+UNFPA+UNICEF) funded by EU SDG Fund, Spain, Sweden. $4.03M total, 2024-2027. Scope: 60 health facilities EHR integration, 3M vaccination records, disability certificates system (120K users), sick leave digitization (280K workers), telemedicine expansion to rural/mountain areas serving 700K children. FHIR/HL7 standards required.
win_probability_rationale: UN procurement rules (CQS) are transparent. EU-funded mandate favors EU-standard technical approach (FHIR/HL7). Some subcomponents already underway (mid-implementation). Best opportunity is sub-contract for telemedicine platform, AI clinical decision support, or mobile health app. WHO/UNDP national office relationships are key.

title: Разработка и внедрение реестра виртуальных активов и системы комплаенс-мониторинга USDKG
title_en: Virtual Asset Registry and Compliance Monitoring System for USDKG Stablecoin
ai_digital_scope: Financial Services Authority procurement for USDKG stablecoin (launched on BNB Chain October 2025) compliance infrastructure. Scope: virtual asset registry, real-time transaction monitoring AI (AML), KYC platform, integration with National Bank digital som system, reporting to the National Council on Virtual Assets. Regulatory tech platform.
win_probability_rationale: No incumbent — brand new regulatory domain. Crypto/virtual asset compliance tech (Chainalysis, Elliptic, Refinitiv) firms are natural candidates. KG is explicitly positioning as a crypto-friendly jurisdiction. FSA procurement is relatively accessible. CIS-based blockchain compliance firms (with Kyrgyz regulatory knowledge) are strongly competitive.

title: Консультационные услуги по разработке вторичного законодательства Цифрового кодекса КР — ИИ и данные
title_en: Consulting Services for Developing Digital Code Secondary Legislation — AI and Data Regulations
ai_digital_scope: Digital Code (Law №178, in force February 2026) secondary regulations drafting. Scope: AI auditability standards (Chapter 23), model registries regulation, testing frameworks for AI government deployment, data governance sub-acts, self-regulatory organization (SRO) framework for AI industry. EU GIZ or UNDP co-funded advisory.
win_probability_rationale: Advisory contract with donor rules. KG explicitly chose 'more carrot than stick' EU-light approach, making EU-style advisors (GIZ, Estonian EGA, Baltic rule-of-law firms) naturally aligned. Short engagement. CQS method allows quality selection. Best opportunity window: Q2 2026 before regulations crystallize.

title: Развитие цифровых навыков молодежи и трудоустройство в цифровой экономике — UNDP
title_en: Youth Digital Skills and Employment in Digital Economy — UNDP Programme
ai_digital_scope: UNDP Kyrgyzstan programme: digital skills training for youth employment in digital economy. Scope: platform development (Russian/Kyrgyz), AI literacy courses, coding bootcamps, HTP resident company job placement pipeline, women in tech component, rural digital access module. Targets: 5,000 youth trained in 2026.
win_probability_rationale: UNDP CQS procurement is transparent. Digital skills training is one of the most accessible categories for international providers. No incumbent. HTP ecosystem (500+ resident IT companies) provides ready placement pipeline. Russian-language curriculum providers and Korean (KOICA-style) EdTech have strong references.

title: Кибербезопасность — аудит и разработка стратегии для органов государственного управления (C4CA проект)
title_en: Cybersecurity Audit and Strategy Development for Government Agencies (C4CA Project)
ai_digital_scope: EU Connectivity for Central Asia (C4CA) project, Jan 2025 – Dec 2028, Expertise France lead. Kyrgyzstan component: national CERT capacity building, government cybersecurity policy framework, training for government cybersecurity units, penetration testing of critical infrastructure (Tunduk, eMoney systems), Digital Code Chapter 23 (AI security) alignment.
win_probability_rationale: EU procurement rules (PRAG) are among the most transparent globally. No incumbent — new EU programme. EU firms (Estonian e-Governance Academy, Finnish CERT-FI, Lithuanian NRD) are natural candidates. C4CA explicitly targets Central Asia. Applications submitted to C4CAprocurement@haus.fi by Nov 2025 — check for 2026 packages.
